runs.text: Do not write code. Write between two and four cases for the fruit order, with the right answer for each one, so that any wrong version fails at least one.

hints.text: Think of possible errors: checking only one supplier, comparing badly with 0, adding too little.
You need a case that is confirmed, to check the sum.
You need a supplier without stock that is not the first one.
5, 3, 2; 0, 3, 2; and 4, 4, 0 uncover the three wrong versions. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Which of your cases could you remove without letting any wrong version escape?
Wrong versions: it only checks the stock of North, it uses
and it confirms with the sum of the first two. A set without a confirmed case does not detect the third; one where only North fails does not detect the first.
